reason: A DSH Web interface customization plugin for uploading or selecting backgrounds, previewing visual adjustments, and persisting background settings locally.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供自定义背景图片、预设氛围、实时预览和本地持久化设置的界面插件。
summaries.en: A DSH Web interface plugin for customizing backgrounds with local images or presets, real-time previews, and persistent settings.

capabilities: customizes the DSH Web background layer
accepts local image uploads and compresses them in the browser
stores background preferences in local DSH settings
provides installation scripts that modify the DSH host settings namespace allowlist
